subject: Next steps: Prompt-suite & Regression Sentinels for OptiScale POC
messages:
From: Ralph Hansen <ralph.hansen@optiscale.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Ortiz <megan.ortiscale@optiscale.com>
Date: 2028-06-30 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Prompt-suite + monitoring for POC

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to move into the POC. Our engineering lead asked for a concise plan for how Redwood will detect regressions during the initial ramp and what the canary/rollback process looks like. Specifically:

- We'll be shipping three prompt families (billing, claims, triage) and want syntax + semantic regression detection.
- We need a basic alerting SLA: when do you notify us vs automatically rollback?
- What artifacts do you need from our side (gold prompts, expected outputs, baseline metrics)?

Can you share a suggested onboarding checklist and any sample prompt-format you expect? Also please attach any eval harness webhook spec we can use to integrate with our QA pipeline.

Cheers,
Ralph
Ralph Hansen
Head of AI Platform, OptiScale
(Attachment: none)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ralph Hansen <ralph.hansen@optiscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30 14:35:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Prompt-suite + monitoring for POC

Hi Ralph — great to hear, and thanks for outlining the asks. High level plan below (I attached the first draft of the prompt suite and the ramp plan):

1) Prompt artifacts we need from OptiScale (by Day 3 of POC)
   - CSV of gold prompts (one row per prompt, columns: id, family, input, expected_output, tolerance_notes) — see attached optiscale_prompt_suite_v1.csv
   - Canonical examples for edge cases or redlines (optional)

2) Eval harness integration (Day 4-6)
   - Redwood will run the eval harness against a shadow copy of your traffic via webhook. We'll provide eval-webhook-spec.md (attached) and a sample request/response.
   - Suggested initial sampling: 2% of requests as parallel eval; ramp up after baseline stability.

3) Canary & rollback policy (Day 7+)
   - Canary window: 24 hours at 1% traffic / shadow-run for 48 hours before 1% live routing.
   - Regression sentinel thresholds: 5% drop in correctness on golden prompts OR 20% increase in high-confidence hallucination signals triggers an alert.
   - Automatic rollback: only if a high-severity sentinel fires AND a correlated spike in user-facing error rate (>1.5x baseline). Otherwise immediate alert to OptiScale on-call and joint triage.

4) Ownership & notifications
   - Redwood SRE (Diego) will own the canary execution and automated rollback playbook.
   - Jasmine (CS) will coordinate communication and runbook handoff with your eng lead.

Next steps: can you confirm the eng contact and whether we should follow the eval webhook out of your QA cluster or your staging API? I'll schedule a 30-min handoff call for tomorrow.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: optiscale_prompt_suite_v1.csv; qmon_ramp_plan_v0.2.xlsx; eval-webhook-spec.md)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Ralph Hansen <ralph.hansen@optiscale.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Prompt-suite + monitoring for POC

Ralph / team — quick technical notes from the runtime/ops side so expectations are clear:

- Eval webhook spec: our harness will POST a JSON payload with the prompt id + input + metadata to your endpoint OR we can expose a webhook endpoint you call with batched samples. See attached spec.

- Sampling & stability metrics:
  * Start: 2% shadow eval (non-blocking) for 48 hours. Collect correctness, confidence distribution, token-latency distribution.
  * Canary: 1% live routing with abort-on-threshold for the first 24 hours.

- Regression detection logic (implementation detail):
  * Golden prompt correctness: weighted F1 measured against expected output tokens using normalized whitespace + punctuation-stripping. 5% relative drop triggers a P2 alert.
  * Semantic drift: embedding cosine shift > 0.12 median across a sliding 1k sample triggers a warning.
  * False positive reduction: we run three-signal consensus (golden prompts, traffic error rate, anomaly in token-level logits) before auto-rollback.

- Rollback steps (automated path):
  1) Canary abort (automated) — immediately stop live routing to the new variant.
  2) Switch to fallback model variant pinned in Dedicated pool.
  3) Notify stakeholders via PagerDuty + email thread.

We should also confirm whether you want a soft-fail policy (alert-only for first occurrence) vs hard-fail (automated rollback). Recommend alert-only for the first week to tune false positive thresholds.

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: eval-webhook-spec.md)

Marissa Cole
